title: Agency 2026 sample explainer: Trail Pass Finder (fictional)
$about: A fictional service, made up for this design repo to show a complete agency-explainer spec. Every name and number is invented and labelled as example values. Do not reuse the figures. Check: python3 scripts/mvai/mvai.py check samples/video/explainer-sample.json

scenes.headline: Trail Pass Finder
scenes.subtitle: A fictional service that shows the explainer format.
scenes.narration: Trail Pass Finder is a fictional service. The sample shows how an Agency explainer fits together.

scenes.headline: Visitors search four websites for one pass
scenes.narration: In this example, a visitor searches four websites to find one trail pass. Each website asks the same questions again.

scenes.headline: How the service works
scenes.label: How it works
scenes.narration: The visitor names a trail and a date. The service checks which passes cover that trail. The service shows the price and the rules. The visitor pays once and gets the pass by email.

scenes.headline: What the visitor gets
scenes.label: Features
scenes.narration: The visitor gets one search box, a clear price, the trail rules and a pass on the phone.

scenes.headline: Example results
scenes.label: Example values
scenes.narration: The sample uses example values. A pass takes two minutes to buy, with one payment and zero repeated questions.
